evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Jeline asks 'What's your first and last name?' and customer responds 'Kayla Bao' but the name is never used again in the call
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No framing given. Rep jumps directly into data collection: 'whether you planning to move ma'am? So I can check the availability'
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves straight into logistics questions
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep does not use a concern-led opening like 'What items are you most concerned about?' Instead begins with 'whether you planning to move' and proceeds through a structured checklist
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Comprehensive details collected: date (Friday Nov 6), property type (house), local move (6 min), square footage (1700 pickup, 2000 dropoff), stories (1 and 2), bedrooms (2+office), garage items (mower, toolchest, grill), driveway access at both ends, box count range discussed
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Box count asked: 'normally ma'am for a 1700 square feet house receive 55 to 65 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range...' Packing services never asked
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identifies move qualifies for walkthrough (destination is 2000 sqft) and offers it: 'Ma'am by any chance, are you available to do a virtual walkthrough? So it's like a video call so I can see the house access as well as the other furniture that we will be moving.' Customer accepts and rep confirms: 'Alright! We can do it right now. I'll just send you a text message with the link...'

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details systematically and correctly identified when the move qualified for a virtual walkthrough, then cleanly routed to the next step with clear next steps (text link, 1-2 minute wait).
coaching_note: Before collecting logistics, establish the customer's concerns first using the two-concerns question, and always use the customer's name at least once more during the call to build rapport — you had Kayla's name but never said it again after the introduction.
